name: @rimcast/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Rimcast (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.json && redocly bundle capacity --output src/.bundled/capacity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle capacity --output src/.bundled/capacity.json && redocly bundle placements --output src/.bundled/placements.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle placements --output src/.bundled/placements.json && redocly bundle telemetry --output src/.bundled/telemetry.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle telemetry --output src/.bundled/telemetry.json && redocly bundle incidents --output src/.bundled/incidents.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle incidents --output src/.bundled/incidents.json && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.json
